summary_en: ANYCOLOR Inc. authorized the acquisition of up to 2.8 million shares (4.67% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 7.0 billion yen through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from September 10, 2026 to April 30, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
On September 9, 2026, ANYCOLOR Inc.'s board of directors approved a share buyback program under the Articles of Incorporation as permitted by the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 2.8 million ordinary shares, representing 4.67% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate price of 7.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between September 10, 2026 and April 30, 2027.

The company positions the buyback as part of its capital allocation framework aimed at enhancing capital efficiency and strengthening shareholder returns. Management intends to balance three competing uses of profits: funding for VTuber business growth through operational expenses and capital investment, shareholder distributions, and internal reserves for future investments. The buyback will be implemented after considering investment capacity, stock price levels, market conditions, and financial outlook.

As of July 31, 2025, ANYCOLOR held 1,177,131 treasury shares against a total of 61,128,029 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
